text:
Asha M.: hey team :wave: signing in for day 2 and iant find the engineers' playbooks or runbook templates in Notion. company home redirects me but clicking "Docs" yields an SSO error (403). anyone else seen this? where is the canonical docs space and who owns the runbook templates?

Tara (DevEx): welcome Asha! :tada: Primary location is Workspace > Spaces > Engineering > Documentation & Playbooks. Read-only link: https://redwood.notion.site/Engineering-Docs-Playbooks. The 403 on click usually means your SSO session didn't fully provision roles yet. Try signing out and back in, or open the Notion invite email and click the link there first.

Asha M.: i signed up with my personal google previously and later got an invite to my work email. That could be the issue. Is there a way to merge or remove the personal account?

Carlos (Platform): yep, Notion treats them as separate users. If you accidentally created a personal account, tell us which email is currently linked and which one you want as primary. We can remove the stray personal user and re-invite your work account. DM me the emails and Ikick off the cleanup.

Lena (Docs Curator): quick note on ownership and templates: the runbook templates are in the "Templates" folder inside the Docs space. We run a quarterly docs-curator rotation—curators own the index and accept template ownership transfers. If you create a new runbook for infra-onboarding, request a transfer and we'll add the owner badge. To request transfer, duplicate the template and then add a comment on the template page with: @Lena + "Ownership request: [New Owner]".

Asha M.: perfect. for the metadata on new templates, do we have a standard header to avoid duplicates? also can i export a PDF for offline reading?

Tara (DevEx): yes, keep the metadata block at the top of every template. Example we expect:

```
Title: Infra Runbook - Cloud Init
Owner: Infra Platform (infra@redwood.com)
Version: 0.1 (draft)
Last edited: 2026-03-10
Status: Draft / Temp
```

When you want a stable copy for others, remove "Temp" and ping the curator to add it to the index. Exports: Notion PDF export is allowed for internal accounts only. For anything that needs to leave the org, file a security-approved export request via the Docs export form: https://forms.redwood.com/docs-export-request.

Carlos (Platform): also, if you're creating a runbook that will be referenced by the oncall rota, add the tag "oncall-relevant" in the metadata or the page tags so the oncall tooling picks it up.

docs-bot: Notion 026-03-10 - New edit request submitted by Asha M. (req-20260310-12).

Asha M.: thanks all! i'll DM @Carlos with the emails and duplicate the runbook template then ping @Lena for ownership transfer. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
